01-practise.title: Practise one phrase
01-practise.story: One hand presses the guitar strings while the learner returns to a short score phrase.
01-practise.alt: A learner practises a short phrase on guitar, with a hand on the fretboard beside a practice sheet.

02-submit.title: Submit an existing recording
02-submit.story: An existing music recording travels into a receiving tray through one clear transfer. This is a conceptual submission illustration, not a product screen.
02-submit.alt: An existing music recording moves into a receiving tray through one link.

Một bản ghi. Một liên kết.

03-listen.title: Listen for one useful detail
03-listen.story: A teacher focuses listening on one marked moment in the learner’s recording. The waveform is illustrative and is not an assessment graph.
03-listen.alt: Headphones and a recorded phrase with one moment marked for the teacher to discuss.

04-feedback.title: A teacher marks the next focus
04-feedback.story: The approved teacher-guidance composition: a pencil marks a bar and a short note gives the next practice focus.
04-feedback.alt: A teacher marks one bar in a practice book and suggests slowing down while keeping the pulse.

05-try-again.title: Return with a clear focus
05-try-again.story: Two attempts stay separate and understandable. The same highlighted bar and teacher focus carry into another attempt; there is no score or guaranteed improvement.
05-try-again.alt: Two practice attempts side by side, linked by the teacher’s instruction to keep a steady pulse.

06-parent-journey.title: Understand the learning journey
06-parent-journey.story: A parent holds a learning journal organised around effort, teacher guidance and the next focus. This is a conceptual communication image, not an available parent-report screen.
06-parent-journey.alt: Hands hold a learning journal showing practice, teacher guidance and the next practice focus.

Điều cần chú ý khi nghe.
